lesson: The system is consistently shorting into oversold conditions and liquidity sweeps, failing to account for mean reversion potential in a bearish structure. By ignoring the divergence between extreme fear sentiment and price action, the model is repeatedly entering at the tail end of bearish momentum.
adjustment: Require a confirmed bearish market structure break (MSB) on the 1H timeframe before entering any short position, rather than relying on lower timeframe bearish alignment.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps less on ARBUSDT when RSI is oversold.
